text: On her seventeenth birthday Mari Collingwood heads into the city for a concert with her friend Phyllis, wearing [the peace symbol necklace her parents gave her|images|clothes, jewellery and keepsakes]. Looking for marijuana, they fall to Krug Stillo's escaped gang, who [drive them to the woods near Mari's own home|trigger|travelling somewhere remote] to rape and kill them. That night the gang knocks on the Collingwoods' door posing as travelling salesmen, and Mari's parents, learning the truth, [turn their house into a slaughterhouse|ending|victims become the evil].
